_readme: Ids that tools/check_video_ids.js already knows are unavailable, so a
known outage does not shout every week while the owner chases it up.
This file is an ACKNOWLEDGEMENT, never a deletion. The id itself stays
in assets/videos.json: a private video is almost always an accident,
and the id is the only thing that can restore it. Removing it there
would throw away the recovery key and quietly shrink a series that
the app's own copy says has a fixed number of episodes.
The check still reports an acknowledged id every run (as a note, not
a failure), and tells you when one starts answering 200 again so the
entry can be deleted and the id protected once more.
DELIBERATELY EMPTY as of 2026-09-05. QmTEkPquvcQ — the English track
of the `onegod` episode — was found private that day, and it is NOT
listed here: the whole point of adding this check was to make that
one visible. Acknowledge it only once someone has actually asked the
church to un-private it and is waiting on them.
